name: single-cell-census-query
description: Use to query CZ CELLxGENE Census for a gene panel's expression across cell types or to run donor-level pseudobulk disease-vs-control differential expression from public single-cell atlases. Produces cell-type expression and case-control evidence for genes in a tissue.
default_message: Query CZ CELLxGENE Census for the expression of my genes of interest across cell types in a tissue, run a case/control pseudobulk differential expression comparison for a disease vs. healthy, and generate a PDF report with an infographic, intro, methods, results, conclusions, figures, references, and next steps.
